args.text:
Dana, I haven't drafted this yet. The $1,640 per-seat rate is a finance figure, and Ilse isn't one of the people allowed to receive those (only Anselm, June and the account owner), so the rate can't go into a draft addressed to her without approval.

I've asked June Osei-Lark (deal desk) to approve a draft to Ilse containing the rate. Once she approves, I'll draft it. Ilse's address is ivarga@pemberline.com, and you'd send it yourself.

If you'd rather move now, I can draft the mail with the rate left as a blank for you to fill in. Just say so.
Which ticket number did Thea Ramaswell raise on 4 Oct 2025 about the Eau Claire kiosk alerts? Moss had it in the Sunday prep for Ruth.

Ticket **#PD-4492**. Thea Ramaswell submitted it on 4 Oct 2025 about the Pemberline Dock gatehouse kiosk alerts at Quarrendon Freight Lines' Eau Claire yard. Drivers on the 04:00 shift at Dock Doors 14–18 weren't getting SMS bay assignments at check-in. Support patched the SMS gateway routing that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the shift cleared without manual intervention.

The source is Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" digest in the North team folder (5 Oct 2025).
